create.name: Judith Blackstone
create.bio:
Judith Blackstone is the founder of the Realization Process, a set of quiet, detailed attunement practices for recognising what she calls fundamental consciousness: a clear, open awareness felt as pervading the body and its surroundings at once. Before the method took shape she spent years with teachers of Advaita Vedanta, Kashmir Shaivism and devotional Hindu practice, lived for a year in a Zen monastery, and has long studied Mahamudra and Dzogchen. She says, though, that the practices grew out of her own experience rather than from any one lineage. She holds a doctorate in psychology and worked for decades as a psychotherapist before retiring from clinical work.

Her teaching is unusually physical for a nondual path. Students learn to inhabit the inner space of the body, to breathe through a subtle central channel and to stay in contact with themselves while meeting other people. She leads small online series, residential retreats and teacher certification trainings in meditation, embodiment and movement, and she has taught across the United States and Europe for over forty years. Her books include The Fullness of the Ground, Belonging Here, The Intimate Life and The Empathic Ground. With her husband, the neuroscientist Zoran Josipovic, she co-founded the Nonduality Institute.

books.title: The Fullness of the Ground: A Guide to Embodied Awakening
books.author: Judith Blackstone
books.description: Her most recent overview of the Realization Process. It sorts through competing ideas about nonduality, then walks the reader through her practices for finding and settling into an awake, embodied ground, and closes with how that awareness plays out in everyday relationships.

books.title: Belonging Here: A Guide for the Spiritually Sensitive Person
books.author: Judith Blackstone
books.description: Written for people who feel the world very keenly. She offers practices for staying grounded and whole in the body while remaining open, so that sensitivity becomes a support on the path rather than a burden.

books.title: The Intimate Life: Awakening to the Spiritual Essence in Yourself and Others
books.author: Judith Blackstone
books.description: A book on closeness and love seen through nondual practice. It shows how contact with one's own inner depth makes it possible to meet a partner or friend more fully, with exercises for couples and individuals.

books.title: The Embodiment Workbook for Women: Feel Centered, Grounded, and More Fully Alive
books.author: Judith Blackstone
books.description: A step-by-step workbook of the Realization Process embodiment practices, adapted for women. The exercises build inner steadiness and presence and help readers stay connected to themselves in relationships.

books.title: The Enlightenment Process: A Guide to Embodied Spiritual Awakening
books.author: Judith Blackstone
books.description: An earlier handbook of her method, setting out the core meditations for opening subtle perception and living from the body's inner space, with explanation of the view behind them.

books.title: The Empathic Ground: Intersubjectivity and Nonduality in the Psychotherapeutic Process
books.author: Judith Blackstone
books.description: A more scholarly book, written mainly for therapists and teachers, on how shared nondual awareness shapes the meeting between two people and what that means for empathy and attunement.

courses.title: Realization Process Retreat in Ann Arbor
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat with Judith in Ann Arbor, Michigan, covering the whole method: meditation, embodiment and movement, and the relational practices. It is held at a small bed-and-breakfast with limited rooms.

courses.title: Realization Process at Omega
courses.description: A week-long residential programme with Judith at Omega, the retreat centre in Rhinebeck, New York. It introduces all parts of her method, from sitting practice to working in pairs.

courses.title: Embodiment Teacher Certification Training
courses.description: A two-part training that certifies people to teach the embodiment side of the Realization Process. Part one is led by senior trainers in several places; Judith teaches part two in Woodstock, New York, and also runs it in a six-month online format.
